summary: More reliable private conversations and Puppy controls.

improvements: Conversation loading avoids a repeated storage read.
Encrypted checkpoints preserve the existing recovery path.
Private-agent startup skips unrelated shared-service route initialization.
fixes: Stopping Puppy confirms cancellation even when the stream closes first.
Software update offers stay available after app updates.
Private connector approvals preserve their owner and pod boundaries.
Memory instructions retain their rules within the existing prompt budget.
security: Files analysis remains opt-in and uses the approved provider boundary.
Existing pods require a qualified image transition and exact owner approval before installation.
Computer Use remains disabled until its cloud isolation gates pass.
